expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, dependencies, owners, APIs, stores, or fallback paths. One dependency patch, two existing registrations and one regression test.
minimum_design: Patch the pinned ssh2 module to retain its standard cipher order without cpu-features. Reuse existing workspace and production dependency patch mechanisms and exercise Docker import plus SSH negotiation.
outcome: API and CLI imports do not execute optional native CPU probing through the Docker transport dependency.

reuse_decisions.name: pnpm patchedDependencies
reuse_decisions.rationale: Apply the same pinned ssh2 patch in workspace installs.

reuse_decisions.name: LOCAL_PATCHED_DEPENDENCIES
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing release owner reapplies patches after npm installs and workspace vendoring.
